subject.title: Draft: add read-only CLI catalog and operator views

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the narrow `commands list/inspect` contract, including the proposed plugin effect, exposure, and hidden metadata?
rationale: Code review cannot choose the permanent public name, canonical registry, Gateway relationship, stable JSON field set, omission behavior, or plugin API evolution policy while the linked RFC remains undecided.

options.title: Adopt narrow commands
options.body: Approve command-owned list and exact inspection while deferring broad operator reports, ownerless tool adapters, and Gateway convergence until concrete consumers justify them.

options.title: Continue as an experiment
options.body: Keep the RFC and draft implementation open without creating a shipped compatibility commitment.

options.title: Defer a core catalog
options.body: Require a concrete core consumer and long-term owner before accepting any permanent command inventory surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt narrow commands
recommendation.body: Approve command-owned list and exact inspection while deferring broad operator reports, ownerless tool adapters, and Gateway convergence until concrete consumers justify them.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest current-main history across both the CLI routing catalog and plugin CLI registration contract affected by this decision.
